Increases news cadence and potential volatility around more frequent updates.
Sets a near-term catalyst window for new disclosures.
Data will be timely but with limited detail; fewer footnotes may add uncertainty.
Regulatory semi-annual with notes remains, preserving fuller visibility twice a year.

This is an early step to align disclosure frequency with peers and increase transparency for a small fleet operator. The catalyst grows if Q3 2026 reveals material changes in rates, utilization, debt, or fleet transactions.
